book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Mabholu gha kukanakila kubhatemu bhange
“Ngamwatemu bhandu bhange, na mwenga ngamwihika kutemuliwa na Chapanga.
Maghambu utemulu ghomwabhatemu bhajinu, ghonihoghu nde ghomwitemuliwaje. Na chipemu chelachela chempema kwa kubhatemu bhajinu, chenihechi nde Chapanga cheanaampemila mwehapa.
Bho, mbona ulibhona likanju lelibhi mu lihu laka ndongu waku, na koni ngacheulubhona luboliti lolubhi mu lihu lako?
Au anaumpwaghila bho ndongu waku, ‘Ndongu, lenda nukubhoha likanju mu lihu laku,’ chikahi wenga wamweti ubhinalu luboliti mu lihu lako?
Wandumila kubheli wenga! Ubhoha hoti luboliti lolubhi mu lihu laku, na panihapa nde anauweza wichu kulibhoha likanju lelibhi mu lihu jaka ndongu wako.
“Ngamwipekeha nakawa hindu ihuhu, wala ngamwilekela lulu palongi ja magholobhe, ngaghihika kukanyata pahi ja magholu ghabhu, na kung'anambuka na kunkachulana mwabhene.
Ulobhaje, ulondaje, uhodimaje
“Ndobhaje, na mwenga anampataje, mlondaje, na mwenga anampataje, muhodimaje, na mwenga anamuhoghuliwa ndyangu.
Maghambu mundu jokapi joalobha ajopalela, na joalonda abhona, na joahodima, anahoghuliwa ndyangu.
Bho, mundu bhole pachilanda jinu joaweza kumpekeha mwana waki liganga, ngati anaandobhiki libumunda?
Au, bho, nane joaweza kumpekeha mwana waki lijoka, ngati anaandobhiki homba?
Bhela anangati mwehapa mwembi mwahakau, mumanyi kwapekeha bhana bhinu hindu yambone, bho, Atati winu wa kunani kumahunde le ngaampeke mwehapa ghambone nakanopi kwa bhala bhabhundobha?
“Ghokapi ghampala bhandu bhunhengila mwehapa, nanamu mubhatendila bhandu bhelabhela. Maghambu jenje nde ndandi ja Shelia jaka Chapanga, na mabholu gha bhalota bhaka Chapanga.
Ndyangu upepandahu
“Njingalaje kwa kupetela ndyangu upepandahu. Maghambu ndyangu nde upana, na indela nde jipana jejijenda ku uyonangeku, na bhandu bhabhapetela indela jeniheji nde bhamaheli.
Nambu indela jejiyenda ku womi nde jipepandahu, na ndyangu wa kujingila monihomu nde upepandahu, na bhandu bhabhajibhona indela jeniheji nde bhachokope.
Nkongu na mapambiku ghaki
“Mulilingalyaje na bhalota bha ichole, bhandu bhabhahika kwinu kwa kunja bhakabhonikana ngati limbelele, nambu mkati nde mabweha makale.
Anamwamanya kwa matendu ghabhu. Bho, bhandu le bhatongo zabibu mu mikongu ja miha, au mapambiku gha mtini mu mingwandu? Ngabhela!
Bhelabhela kila nkongu wambone upambika mapambiku ghambone, na kila nkongu uhakau upambika mapambiku mahakau.
Nkongu wambone ngacheuweza kupambika mapambiku mahakau, na nkongu uhakau ngacheuweza kupambika mapambiku ghambone.
Kila nkongu wangakupambika mapambiku ghambone anauhekatwaje, na kulekaleka mumotu.
Bhela, anamwamanyaje kwa matendu ghabhu.
Ngachenummanyi mwehapa
“Nga kila mundu joambwaghila, ‘Bambo, Bambo,’ anaajingala mu Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde, nambu jola pena joaghatenda mapalu gha Atati wangu joabhi kunani kumahunde.

Lichobha lela la utemulu palihikaje, bhandu bhamaheli anabhambwaghilaje, ‘Bambo, Bambo! Bho, ngachetwahengiki ulota kwa lihina laku, na kwa lihina laku kubhoha majobhe, na kwa lihina laku kuhenga ngangachu yamaheli?’
Panihapa nepani ananapwaghilaye hotuhotu, ‘Ngachenumanyi mwehapa ng'o, mbokanyaje palongi jangu, mwenga mabhandu mwentenda mahakau!’
Bhachenga bhabheli bha nyumba
“Bhela, kila mundu joaghajowana malobhi ghangu, na kughatenda, jonihoju alengana na mundu joabhi na malangu, joachengiki nyumba jaki panani ja liganga.
Iyula jikatonyiki, mikoka jakatwelili machi, na mpongu ukapuliki na kujilapula nyumba jela. Nambu nyumba jeniheji ngachejahawike, maghambu jakachengakiki panani ja liganga.
“Nambu kila mundu joajowana malobhi ghangu, na ngacheaghahenga, jonihoju alengana na mundu ng'ang'a, joachengiki nyumba jaki panani ja luhanga.
Iyula jikatonyiki, na mikoka jikatwelili machi nakanopi, mpongu ukolongwa ukapula na kujilapula nyumba jela, najombi jakahawiki, kwa nking'indu ukolongwa!”
Lujiniku lwaka Yesu
Yesu paakajomwi kulongela malobhi ghanihagha, lipogha la bhandu bhakakangichi namaa kwa mabholu ghaki.
Maghambu ngacheakabhi abhola ngati bhabhola bha Shelia, nambu akabholiki ngati mundu joabhi na lujiniku.
